nodes.title: Round 7 F (learning-how-this-child-learns, part 2; main 2026-11-04: hedged and count-based until real data): parents see the explain formats Taxila CHOSE, from decision_record point explain_format (Brain applied patch 008 at b59a83e83), as counts of what Taxila did, never as a claim about how the child learns. Monthly report S5 'ways.used' { n new ideas explained, k ways, t of them with the most used way } in en, hinglish and hi. Formats render through WAY_LABEL plain words, and F-codes never render. It is held until the month has WAYS_MIN_N = 4 explain decisions in counted lessons (U), cap 1, ordered after routine, and dropped first when the body is over budget. check.js re-derives n, k, way and t from the raw decision rows of the month's counted lessons. RENDER_VERSION pr-4. The teaching page adds per lesson up to two lines '{T} explained N new ideas with <way>' after the child's requests. The drawer copy says it is what Taxila did, not how your child learns. The report lexicon rejected the superlative 'sabse', so the line states counts only. Reverse if: the population posterior shows a clear per-band winner (then the line may say which way Taxila is trying first, still never a child trait).
